doctrine: Training evidence must distinguish a reusable implementation from an exact artifact campaign. Verify production workflows at their real objective, device, data, persistence, and lifecycle scope. Every admitted objective must prove uninterrupted/split equivalence and atomic checkpoint identity. A successful GUI run must publish a trace and an evaluation-required decision; promotion remains withheld until held-out evidence exists. Committed training specifications identify the exact model, dataset, commit, span, measurements, and evidence bytes, and a generated matrix exposes their strongest claims without upgrading smoke evidence. Missing model artifacts remain explicit verification gaps, never passes.
